title: Exceptions: explain a failure and preserve the original input
goal: Handle an expected conversion failure while preserving input and avoiding a false successful zero.
prerequisites: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.
outcomes: Trace Попытка and Исключение for invalid and valid input.
Distinguish a technical exception from a negative-duration business rule.
Write actionable feedback and a reproducible incident record without secrets.
sections: An operation may fail to produce a value

Число("30") produces a number; Число("ошибка") cannot perform the requested conversion. An exception interrupts the ordinary sequence. The remaining instructions in Попытка are skipped and control moves to Исключение. Результат = Истина is therefore not reached in the main example.

The initial flag is Ложь. It represents conversion success in this exercise only, not knowledge assessment, a saved document or permission to accept any number as a duration. Execution after КонецПопытки follows an explicitly chosen recovery path.
Catch where you can provide a useful response

Keep the risky conversion in a narrow block. Combining many unrelated operations makes the failed action harder to identify. An empty exception handler hides a missing result while allowing the program to appear active.

A learner-facing message should explain the next action and give an example. Developers need reproducible steps and the failure location. Do not automatically publish raw diagnostics containing paths, records or connection details. This exercise retains its synthetic input in a local variable and sends nothing outside.
Technical conversion is not business validation

The text "-1" can convert successfully. A negative duration still violates our service rule. Check the range after conversion; catching an exception does not replace that check or make an invalid value acceptable.

Distinguish unreadable text, a converted but unacceptable number, and an acceptable number. Zero can be valid under the chosen rule. Returning zero for every failure would erase the distinction between a known value and missing or rejected input.

Record input, execution location, action, expected result and actual result. A synthetic string and short message suffice here; no full database, password or borrowed configuration is needed. A result from a different source version does not verify this experiment.

First run invalid text and observe the prompt and Ложь. Change only the input to "30": the prompt should disappear and the flag become Истина. Then investigate "-1" and specify the additional range check. This covers the recovery path and the ordinary path.

lab.title: Exceptions: explain a failure and preserve the original input
lab.environment: Official locally installed training platform; a separate personal file infobase, no Studio required.
steps: Identify the skipped instruction after conversion failure and explain the final flag.

Close only your own Enterprise session. Open your training copy in Designer. Preserve the previous module text separately. Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler; replace only the preceding exercise body inside it. Do not replace modules of an unfamiliar application.
Copy the main example between the existing handler declaration and КонецПроцедуры. Do not add another handler. Read the explanation and identify what changes after each line.
Save your source, complete the database update and start Enterprise mode. Read the message area and compare each actual output with your prediction.
Replace "ошибка" with "30" and run again. Separately try "-1" and explain why conversion does not prohibit it.

evidence: Source version, predicted and actual outputs.
One changed input and a trace explaining its result; no automatic grading claim.
lab.negative: Do not leave an empty handler, mark failure as success or substitute zero for an unknown result.

mistakes: Continuing after a catch does not imply success.
Track an explicit result and test valid and invalid input.
Check the permitted duration range after conversion.
Raw technical errors should not be forwarded indiscriminately.
Give actionable feedback and retain only non-sensitive technical diagnostics.

quiz.question: What happens to the remaining instructions inside Попытка after an exception?
options: They are skipped as control moves to the handler

quiz.question: Does Число("-1") validate nonnegative duration?
quiz.explanation: Conversion and business validation are different.

quiz.question: Why test "30" after an invalid string?
options: To verify the ordinary successful path
quiz.explanation: Rejecting every input is not a correct fix.
